pages.text: $(item)Frontier Regolith$(). Rock ground to dust by billions of years of micrometeorites. Assayed in bulk it gives back its interstellar dust and a little rare earth.
$(thing)Found$(): The top of every island of the Accretion Frontier (except the Lensing Void).$(br2)$(thing)Used$(): The Spectrograph assays eight into four Interstellar Dust and a Rare Earth Oxide.
